strategy.thesis: Corporate venture arm of Teva Pharmaceutical Industries — Israel's largest pharmaceutical company — that invests in early-stage Israeli drug-development startups and strikes university licensing deals to expand Teva's innovative-drug pipeline.

summary.en: Teva Innovative Ventures is the corporate venture arm of Teva Pharmaceutical Industries, launched in 2011 under Dr. Aharon Schwartz to invest in Israeli biomedical startups and license university drug-discovery technology.

strategy.thesis: 50/50 joint venture between Teva Pharmaceutical Industries and Philips that funds and incubates Israeli medtech, digital-health and bio-convergence startups; evolved in 2023 into the Series A/B follow-on fund Sanara Capital.

size.raw: combined NIS 100 million ($26M) pledged by Teva and Philips over 8 years

summary.en: Sanara Ventures is a Teva-Philips joint-venture incubator/fund in Ra'anana backing Israeli medtech, digital-health and bio-convergence startups, with roughly 20 active portfolio companies across its seed (Sanara Ventures) and Series A/B (Sanara Capital) vehicles.

strategy.thesis: Biotech incubator set up by Merck KGaA (as Merck Serono) inside its Israel R&D center to fund and lab-house early-stage Israeli biotech startups in oncology, neurodegeneration, rheumatology and fertility — the first such incubator run by a multinational pharma company in Israel without government funding.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Provides seed financing plus access to dedicated lab facilities inside Merck Serono's Israel R&D center.

summary.en: Merck Serono Israel BioIncubator was Merck KGaA's self-funded biotech incubator inside its Yavneh R&D site, seeding Israeli startups in oncology, neurodegenerative disease, rheumatology and fertility from 2011.

verification_notes: Parent Merck KGaA is headquartered in Darmstadt, Germany; this is a dedicated Israel-based program, included per region rules for foreign firms running a dedicated local arm. Could not confirm if the program is still operating today — Merck later launched a second Israel biotech vehicle, ExploreBio (2018, with WuXi AppTec), tracked as a separate entity in this dataset.

strategy.thesis: Pre-seed/early-stage biotech incubator at Merck's Yavne complex, launched by Merck KGaA with China's WuXi AppTec (plus Israeli investor Mori Arkin and life-sciences VC Pontifax), writing checks of roughly €1-1.5M per company per year into Israeli biotech startups.

summary.en: ExploreBio is a Merck KGaA / WuXi AppTec biotech incubator based at Merck's Yavne site, investing pre-seed and early-stage capital into Israeli pharma/biotech startups.

strategy.thesis: Venture studio backed by AstraZeneca, Merck KGaA, Pfizer and Teva (alongside Israel Biotech Fund, Amiti Ventures, AWS and BioMed X, with Israel Innovation Authority support) that co-builds AI-driven drug-discovery startups in Rehovot, giving founders direct pharma R&D validation plus pre-seed capital.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Co-development model with pharma partners (AstraZeneca, Merck KGaA, Pfizer, Teva) providing R&D champions and real-world validation; operated jointly with research institute BioMed X.

summary.en: AION Labs is a Rehovot-based venture studio founded in 2021 by AstraZeneca, Merck KGaA, Pfizer and Teva together with Israel Biotech Fund, Amiti Ventures and AWS to build AI-powered drug-discovery startups.

strategy.thesis: Digital-health investment consortium pairing Israel's largest HMO, Maccabi Healthcare Services, with global pharma corporate investors Amgen (via Amgen Ventures) and Medison (via Medison Ventures) to fund graduates of Maccabi's technology incubator and other early-stage Israeli diagnostics/digital-health startups.

summary.en: eHealth Ventures is a Tel Aviv digital-health fund/incubator consortium of HMO Maccabi Healthcare Services with pharma corporate investors Amgen and Medison, backing early-stage Israeli digital-health and diagnostics startups.

strategy.thesis: Corporate venture arm of Medison Pharma — one of the world's largest commercialization partners for innovative pharma companies — investing in biotech, pharma and digital-health companies and giving portfolio companies access to Medison's global pharma partner network (Biogen, Vertex, Ipsen, PTC Therapeutics, Daiichi-Sankyo, and others).

summary.en: Medison Ventures is the corporate venture arm of Israeli pharma commercialization company Medison Pharma, founded in 2016 by Meir Jakobsohn to invest in biotech, pharma and digital-health companies.
